methods.label: Choose the three smallest numbers
methods.explanation:
To make the sum as small as possible, choose the three smallest different numbers. Any other selection replaces at least one of these with a larger number and therefore increases the sum.

Ordering the set gives
\[
-3<-1<7<12<25.
\]
Thus the smallest sum is
\[
(-3)+(-1)+7=-4+7=\boxed{3},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
